version: LOCK 61 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: A ring found in the masjid
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A ring found in the masjid
missions.kicker: River Market · A ring found in the masjid
missions.button: Something is shining under a prayer mat

a.text: Under a prayer mat you find a silver ring with a worn stone. Nobody is near.

choices.label: Ask Yunus to announce it after each prayer

announce.text: Yunus calls it out after Asr: a ring found in the masjid; its owner can ask the muezzin.

keep.text: You sell the ring to Karim for eight coins.

missions.title: The ring's owner
missions.button: Umm Salim is asking about a ring

a.text: Umm Salim the widow has heard the announcement. The ring was her late husband's - she lost it the day she came to pray for him.

b.text: She holds it to her lips and can't speak. Later Salma tells everyone who found it.
